items.name: FLIP Rubik Open 2016
items.information: Competition is held during the "31ème Festival Ludique International de Parthenay", famous big games festival from 6 to 17 july 2016 . In the streets and venues, lots of vendors and games creators, animations, shows, video games, board games, card games, classics (chess, checkers, tarot, poker ...)... competition and festival websites : see below Competition is open from 10am to 12 pm on saturday and sunday from 1:30pm to 6pm. Limit of 35 competitors. Free bedrooms are offered in a school 20' by foot far from the venue, registration for bedrooms to be requested asap to the organiser: [Jean-Louis MATHIEU](mailto:rubikfr88@gmail.com) places are limited, do not be late to ask.
